items.html: And behold, it was explained above that there are three aspects in the time of pregnancy alone, which correspond to the three times that ZA has, which are pregnancy, nursing, and Mochin. And it is known that also in the nursing alone there will be these three aspects, as I have written their detail. And now we shall explain them in general, and there we shall explain them according to the order of the times that each and every one has.
